conclusion.rationale: The primary compatibility change (PCA-0001, CONFIG_CLI_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE) changes the precedence of HTTP proxy environment variables from uppercase-first to lowercase-first. When both HTTP_PROXY and http_proxy are set with different values, Go HTTP clients will now use the lowercase value instead of the uppercase one. This is a deliberate change (Go issue #79656) to align with industry convention. QUIC internal changes (PCA-0002, PCA-0003) are bug fixes that don't break backward compatibility. Coverage gate at 21.4% reflects only the high-priority finding being covered; QUIC changes remain untested due to infrastructure requirements.
recommended_actions: Applications that rely on HTTP_PROXY uppercase env var overriding lowercase should update to match the new precedence
